sections.Profile:
Cheetah , released by Stern Electronics in June 1980, is a four-player solid-state widebody with a jungle theme, designed by Harry Williams, whose Add-a-Ball feature can stack up to five extra balls; 1,223 were built.

- Manufacturer: Stern Electronics
- Years made: 1980
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Jungle, Original Theme, Stern Electronics, Solid State, Widebody, Animals, Fantasy, 1980s
sections.Editions: - Cheetah: 1,223 made, released 1980-06-01, model number 116, Stern M-200 MPU
